gate_title: Post-PYT canonical shard cutover and CI rationalisation boundary
operator_instruction_effect: Resume the first incomplete eligible CIPR packet through gate preparation only; it does not grant the operator-reserved G5 cutover.

current_authority.canonical_complete_suite: PYTHONPATH=src:. python3 -m pytest tests -q --tb=short via required job name tests
current_authority.python_runner_state: PYT COMPLETED / PYTEST canonical full-suite runner
current_authority.legacy_unittest: rollback/parity surface, not current canonical complete-suite authority
current_authority.profile_selection: FAST/PACKET/FINAL_HEAD advisory early assurance; final assurance remains mandatory

current_tests_workflow.second_command_assessment: Redundant with normal recursive pytest collection unless explicitly excluded elsewhere; the current workflow provides no such exclusion.

current_tiered_workflow.legacy_required_context: OVC tiered test selection shadow is an echo-only compatibility context after profile assurance
current_tiered_workflow.merge_readiness: Meaningful late-bound exact-final integration stage and explicitly required by current main ruleset verification

findings.finding: The G4 deterministic shard candidate proves exact union only for the legacy unittest population. PYT-G2 subsequently changed canonical complete-suite authority to pytest tests and admitted pytest-native tests. The old shard proof therefore cannot substitute for the current canonical tests surface.
Fresh full-suite execution is 335.62 seconds on the inspected PR head, materially above the pre-PYT canonical baseline used by G4 shadow evidence.

tests.yml reruns tests/research_console_vnext after running pytest tests. The repeated subtree was 99 tests in 0.95 seconds, so removing it is correct rationalisation but not the primary 5+ minute latency remedy.

The visible OVC tiered test selection shadow compatibility job performs only an echo after OVC profile assurance. Retirement or context migration still requires exact ruleset/consumer verification before change.
SIQ READY and OVC merge readiness carry distinct payload qualification and exact-final late-placement semantics. Their semantics must not be removed merely to reduce visible check count.

proposed_authority_delta.decision_scope: Whether to activate the previously shadow-qualified legacy-unittest deterministic shard candidate as a substitute within the post-PYT canonical assurance path.
not_included: scientific, semantic, selector, family, Validation, publication, probability, risk, exposure, trading or execution authority
force-push, history rewrite or destructive deletion
automatic removal of SIQ READY or OVC merge readiness semantics
automatic removal of PYT parity jobs
any shard mapping that omits pytest-native canonical tests

acceptance_conditions: candidate population identity equals the current canonical pytest collection, not merely the legacy unittest subset
zero omission, duplication or nondeterministic assignment across the current canonical population
same-head shadow aggregate equals canonical complete-suite outcome
PYT parity/rollback guarantees remain satisfied or are explicitly superseded by operator authority
OVC merge readiness exact-final semantics remain intact
ruleset/required-context changes are proven before context retirement
measured current critical-path improvement is material without weakening assurance
rollback restores current required CI without history rewrite

blocking_warnings: G4 shard proof does not cover the current post-PYT canonical pytest surface.

warnings: A PASS on the old shard candidate would weaken current canonical coverage because pytest-native tests are outside its proven population.
Removing the duplicate Research Console rerun is safe to investigate but only saves about one second in the inspected run.
The echo-only tiered compatibility context is a consolidation candidate, but exact required-context consumers must be verified before retirement.
SIQ READY may be a UI/check-surface consolidation candidate only if its qualification/receipt semantics remain preserved inside the integration path.
unresolved_issues: No current canonical pytest deterministic shard union has yet been built and shadow-qualified.
rollback: DEFER/BLOCK leaves current CI exactly unchanged. Preserve the G4 shadow evidence and this G5 reconciliation. Do not activate the old shard candidate, delete tests, change required checks or rewrite history.
exact_work_after_defer: prepare a bounded post-PYT canonical collection census and current heavy-test inventory from then-current main
build a current-canonical pytest shard candidate in shadow only if deterministic sharding remains preferred
prove exact union including pytest-native tests and repeat same-head equivalence
measure current critical path over repeated comparable runs
prepare one consolidated successor decision packet covering any required-check substitution/removal and any PR-check context consolidation
exact_work_after_pass: NOT_RECOMMENDED: do not execute PASS on the legacy shard candidate without first satisfying all acceptance conditions above; a bare PASS would be treated as insufficient/ambiguous authority and must stop.
